title: Akhenaten tribute at the Hale Solar Laboratory

tellings.quote: When he designed the Hale Solar Laboratory in Pasadena, he included a tribute to Akhenaten in the arch above the entrance,

plain: When the astronomer George Ellery Hale designed his Hale Solar Laboratory in Pasadena in the 1920s, Michels says, he put a tribute to Akhenaten, the Egyptian pharaoh who worshipped the sun, in the arch above the entrance. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about pagan ritual and secret science around NASA, as a sign of ancient religious ideas running through modern science.
